notes: The tutorial offers two alternatives (potentiometer OR photoresistor + 10k resistor). The text describes the potentiometer wiring and only 3 jumper wires are listed, so I built the potentiometer circuit. The photoresistor and 10k resistor are not included, because both variants use the same A0, 5V and GND connections.
The photoresistor variant would use the photoresistor from 5V to a node on A0, plus a 10k resistor from that node to GND.

The optional external LED circuit is included: pin 13, 220 ohm resistor, LED anode, LED cathode, GND next to pin 13 (GND.3). The two extra wires for it go beyond the 3 listed, because the listed 3 cover only the sensor circuit. The built-in LED on pin 13 can be used instead.

Breadboard hole positions are estimated from the images. The pot straddles the centre gap: its middle pin is in column 11 on one half, and its outer pins are in columns 10 and 12 on the other half. Bank letters follow the catalogue naming (t = rows a-e, b = rows f-j).
Pot outer pins: GND goes to Arduino GND (the second GND in the power header, GND.2) and VCC goes to 5V. The middle pin (wiper) goes to A0.
The LED, resistor and wire positions on the breadboard (columns 20-25) are my own choice, because the images don't show them.
